failure_origin: CCD ideal-coordinate validation before bound ligand repair
new_message: The CCD reference geometry could not be validated for missing-atom repair. Reference coordinates disagree with CCD stereochemistry at C14: expected R, found S. No coordinates were changed. Supply a validated complete ligand reference; the input structure was not modified.
decision: Preserve source and the failure. No observed atoms, CCD stereodescriptors or ring atom names were changed to force acceptance. A validated complete chemical/coordinate reference is needed.
